description_en: The Ganedyaḥ Temple of Sunāguthi is attached to the eastern wall of Bhṛṅgāreśvara Mahādeva (SUN0100). This temple is also located nearby the Bālakumārī Temple at Capāphaḥ.The two-tier temple has been built on a single plinth and stands on four timber columns with one at each corner. The roofs are supported by carved struts showing images of Aṣṭamātṛkās and erotic figures. The temple has masonry walls on its southern and western sides. The main entrance is on the east and is flanked by two small lions. Above it, one can see atoraṇashowing an image of a four-handed Gaṇeśa. The northern side displays latticed woodwork on top of a low brick wall. The main statue of Gaṇeśa is located inside and is attached to the western wall. The other face of this wall is part of the Bhṛṅgāreśvara Mahādeva temple complex, which contains shrines of Sarasvatī, Mahākāla and Rādhākṛṣṇa. The southern wall of the temple has a Nāsaḥdyaḥ shrine which has been built on a solid masonry base of 180 cm x 54 cm. Adharmadhātujinālayacaityais located to the north of the temple.According to the inscription from NS 801, the temple was made by Kṛṇasiṃha Bhāro and his followers in 1681 CE. It was reconstructed in 2012. Before religious activities such as Bhīmarathārohaṇa, Vratabandha (initiation) etc. begin, people from the Sunaguthi Ṭola first visit this temple to worship their local deity.
description_ne: भृङ्गारेश्वर मन्दिरको पूर्वी पर्खालसँग सटेको यो गनेद्यः मन्दिर सुनागुथिको थानगणेश मन्दिर हो । दुई तहको छाना भएको यस मन्दिरको तल्लो छाना अड्याउन प्रयोग गरिएको टुँडालमा अष्टमातृका कुँदिएको छ । टुँडाको तल्लो भागमा कामकलासँग सम्बन्धित चित्र कुँदिएका छन् । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि काठको तोरण राखिएको छ । तोरणको बीचमा चार हात भएको गणेश कुँदिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पूर्वाभिमुख गरी चार हात भएको गणेशको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको दक्षिणपट्टिको गारोसँगै जोडिएर नास:द्य: स्थापना गरिएको छ भने पश्चिममा सरस्वती लगायत महाकाल र राधाकृष्णको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको उत्तरमा एउटा धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो मन्दिर नेसं ८०१ मा राजा श्रीनिवास मल्लको राज्यकालमा थकालि कृष्णसिंह भारो सहितको समूहले यो मन्दिरको निर्माण गरेका थिए । विसं २०६८ सालमा यस मन्दिरको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । सुनागुथिमा कसैको व्रतबन्ध वा भीमरथारोहण जस्ता शुभकार्य गर्नुपर्दा सबभन्दा पहिले यसै मन्दिरमा आएर पूजा गर्नुपर्ने परम्परा छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Kṛṇasiṃha Bhāro and his followers made this temple in 1681 during the reign of King Śrīnivāsa Malla.
Bisaṃdāsa and his wife Phulamāyā established thisdharmadhātujinālaya caityain memory of their parents Haridāra and Jogamāyā.
The temple was renovated with the use of donations made by the residents of Sunaguthi Ṭola.
